items.q: I remember hearing a pianist by the name of Claude Hopkins, in fact he was one of the first pianists that I heard that impressed me

ctx.x: And as I told you, I'd heard Fats Waller play, and several other musicians, incidentally. I remember hearing a pianist by the name of Claude Hopkins, in fact he was one of the first pianists that I heard that impressed me that he had a very intellectual and softer musical approach to playing jazz.
